name: Design System Synthesizer
description: Read a WordPress site's representative pages, theme files, and media library to extract a complete reusable design system — logo, color palette, typography, spacing scale, component patterns. Persist it AND generate a visible style-guide page on the site that renders the tokens visually.
author: Respira Team
trigger: build a design system for my site

changelog.1.4.2: On a published page, the check prefers rendered:true so structure and contrast get checked against the live render too.
changelog.1.4.1: The activation step now mentions what activation unlocks: respira_check_design can score any build or saved page against the active direction.
changelog.1.4.0: Persists to the Design Direction owner layer: respira_save_design_direction saves a schema-validated draft (readiness in the response), the final step offers respira_activate_design_direction, and the legacy respira_design_system option write remains only as a fallback for older plugins. Guessed tokens must carry inferred:true.
